description: The castle of Mesocco is a consolidated ruin on a rock above the Moesa, with the remains of its wall towers and the Romanesque bell tower of San Carpoforo, and Santa Maria del Castello at the northern approach. It is not an intact fortress and not the San Bernardino Pass. The Open-Meteo model is clear and mild, with little wind and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
